title: pd-303
description: `pd-303` is an acid-style synthesizer with a 16-step, scale-quantized sequencer, square/saw waveform selection, and controls for filter cutoff, resonance, envelope modulation, accent, decay, and slide. Drive its `CLK` input with triggers, gates, or a clock; patterns can be randomized and stored or recalled in four slots, while separate outputs provide audio, sequencer pitch CV, and envelopes.
